mentions.claim_text: He asks that America be visited again with the greatest revival from sea to shining sea, with one more push in which everyone sees a Holy Ghost Woodstock in the fields, and asks that Hawaii not be forgotten.
mentions.quote: every one of them will see a Holy Ghost Woodstock in the fields
mentions.falsify_match: Mass open air revival meetings across America.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such meetings.

mentions.claim_text: He says listeners are sons and daughters of God who hear the spirit themselves and do not need prophetic voices to tell them what is coming, and that his own assignment is to pray for the nations.
mentions.quote: you don't need prophetic voices to tell you what's coming
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement about his own role.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though it sits oddly against a channel built on telling people what is coming.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to pray over the young man running Brazil, that he saw a new David rising up in Brazil, and to pray for the Brazilian people.
mentions.quote: I saw a new David rising up in Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: A young leader emerges in Brazil cast in that mould.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such figure.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is stretching out and believing God for big things, noting there are eight billion people and many will be in the tribulation, and that he wants to reach the nations.
mentions.quote: I'm stretching out and believing God for big
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of intent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says an angel told him it had a message about Israel: the fig tree is ripe and Ezekiel 38 and 39 are at the door, and he saw figs on the tree double their normal size.
mentions.quote: The fig tree is ripe, and Ezekiel 38 39 is at the door
mentions.falsify_match: A Russia led coalition war against Israel begins.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such war. At the door has no defined end, so this cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what is in the listener's heavenly account and what they are doing to help their pastor, contrasting a dollar given with what a person is worth.
mentions.quote: What's in your heavenly account?
mentions.falsify_match: Givers are visibly better off.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The condition puts any shortfall on the giver.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president saying crypto is bigger than big and that the Clarity Act needs to be done, and asks the audience to believe God for it, then refers back to what the Lord showed him about the family.
mentions.quote: Clarity act needs to be done
mentions.falsify_match: The Clarity Act passes.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: Saying he is not a financial adviser and is giving his opinion of what he has been told, he cites two billion dollars and says he saw coins as five major pillars marching themselves into a new Trump building.
mentions.quote: I saw the coins, five major pillars marching into a new Trump building
mentions.falsify_match: Five named cryptocurrencies become dominant and are tied to a Trump venture.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such consolidation.

mentions.claim_text: He says the president will push hard for major chip producers in America so Taiwan is not needed, that he saw China trying to take Taiwan, and that the Lord said he will hold a covering over Taiwan, with South Korea, Japan, Australia and the Philippines alongside.
mentions.quote: I will hold a covering over Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: China attempts to take Taiwan and fails.
mentions.falsify_miss: China takes Taiwan, or never attempts it. Both a non-attempt and a failed attempt would be read as the covering holding.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him this is not a terrorist attack but an act of war by what has infiltrated America, that they are truly hidden sleeper cells, and that there will be no internet chatter from an ISIS enthusiast to warn of it.
mentions.quote: This is not a terrorist attack. This is an act of war
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack in America traced to state direction rather than a lone actor.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. The absence of chatter is given in advance as expected, so a lack of warning signs confirms rather than weakens it.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over cities where he says cells are present, he says he was shown the Boston Red Sox and New York Yankees stadiums and does not know why, and prayed over the games and baseball in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I was shown Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees. I don't know why
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at either stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No incident.

mentions.claim_text: He says great shakings are coming and America as it is known will change majorly, and that the Lord said he has given a four year window with the president and asks whether it will be squandered or used.
mentions.quote: I've given you a window with President Trump. What will you do
mentions.falsify_match: A period of relative opportunity through the term.
mentions.falsify_miss: The window is interrupted. Because it is conditioned on what people do with it, a bad outcome is attributable to them.

mentions.claim_text: He explains a cruise ship behind him as the picture of the nation's turn: this is the beginning of the turn, but a boat takes a long time to come around while a plane can change direction fast.
mentions.quote: a boat takes a long time to turn around
mentions.falsify_match: A slow but visible national turnaround.
mentions.falsify_miss: No turnaround. The slowness clause means an absence of results in any given period does not count against it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them what the Lord tells him to say, and that praying over Israel he saw Netanyahu and saw a figure he calls Gates come back, which people had doubted.
mentions.quote: I saw Gates come back. Everybody thought I was
mentions.falsify_match: The named figure returns to Israeli politics.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says plainly that he saw Israeli intelligence take Netanyahu out, calls it a hard thing to say, and moves straight to prayer.
mentions.quote: I saw Mossad takes BB out
mentions.falsify_match: Netanyahu is removed or killed with Israeli intelligence involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: He leaves office by ordinary political means or remains.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw churches burning across Europe, America and Canada, that the Islamic Brotherhood will start it, and that they will poke a giant which is his church and it will wake up.
mentions.quote: It's the Islamic Brotherhood that will start doing this
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson attributed to Islamist actors at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson continues from other causes. Attribution is the part that can fail, and most church arson has other causes.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the burned church was built in the 1870s and moves on.
mentions.quote: It was built in 1870. So old
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a detail of a reported fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He notes an energy department emergency declaration for the largest American power grid as a heat dome threatens demand for 160 million people.
mentions.quote: the energy department has declared an emergency for the nation's largest power grid
mentions.falsify_match: The grid fails under the load.
mentions.falsify_miss: It holds. Emergency declarations under heat are routine and usually end without outage.

mentions.claim_text: Saying he does not want to add to or take away from anything, he says the Lord told him to pray over power stations across America, that he saw it in the south, and major disruptions of up to three weeks for some people, cause unknown.
mentions.quote: I saw up to three weeks for some people
mentions.falsify_match: A three week power outage affecting part of America.
mentions.falsify_miss: No outage of that length.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats an instruction to pray over the little boy named George, saying a Harry Potter spirit of witchcraft will try to come on him in the days ahead and that he has been selected.
mentions.quote: A Harry Potter spirit will try to come on him
mentions.falsify_match: The young prince is publicly associated with occult practice.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not. The claim concerns a spirit, so it cannot be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the Cuban and American flags touching at the tips and merging, with the American red and white stripes transferring onto Cuba's blue and white ones, but only partly rather than the whole flag.
mentions.quote: It wasn't the whole flag, but there was a joining
mentions.falsify_match: A formal political union or protectorate arrangement between America and Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such arrangement.

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether he saw the ark of the covenant, he says he only saw tablets and a rod with blossoms on it, that the Lord said they will try to destroy these discoveries, and that he saw the American military stepping in.
mentions.quote: All I saw was tablets and a rod and it had blossoms on it
mentions.falsify_match: An artefact matching that description is found and disputed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such find. He declines to say it is the ark when offered the chance.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia is ready to unleash its weapons because its oil was blown up and is going after Kyiv, and repeats waiting for a Jason Bourne moment to take the Ukrainian president out.
mentions.quote: Russia is ready to unleash their stuff because they blew up their oil
mentions.falsify_match: A major Russian escalation against Kyiv and the removal of Zelensky.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he watched a figure give a scientist the idea of splicing a virus into obesity medicine and heart medicine, and that it was a drain on Europe's and America's economies, saying these people must be judged.
mentions.quote: how to splice a virus in with obesity medicine
mentions.falsify_match: A pathogen is traced to contamination of prescription medication.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such contamination.

mentions.claim_text: Against a clip putting obesity costs at eighty billion dollars a year, he says he saw Satan at the head of the table.
mentions.quote: I saw Satan and he was the head of the
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is about a spiritual meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He sees an angel by an open door concerning Israel and repeats that the fig tree is ripe and full of figs.
mentions.quote: The fig tree is ripe. The fig tree is full of figs
mentions.falsify_match: An Ezekiel 38 scale war against Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such war.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is bringing the harvesting equipment because the harvest is plentiful and the labourers few, that a major move is coming and a door is being opened, with a river flowing through Israel.
mentions.quote: I'm bringing the harvesting equipment
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious movement among Israelis.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says a stronghold of witchcraft over certain nations in South America and Africa will break and lose its grip, that God is dealing with it, and that the glorious church will take back those held captive.
mentions.quote: a stronghold of witchcraft on certain nations will break
mentions.falsify_match: Marked church growth in named South American and African countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such growth. He names no country, so any growth anywhere would be claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He applies the blood over the nation from the Gulf up over Canada, prays over Toronto and says there are plots in Toronto.
mentions.quote: I pray over Canada, Toronto. There's plots in Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: A plot is uncovered in Toronto.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts nations quick to repent with this one, which he calls stiff, and says God will have to do a greater shaking because he wishes none should perish but all come to repentance.
mentions.quote: This one is stiff. I have to do a greater shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A national event severe enough to produce mass religious return.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event.

mentions.claim_text: He declares he will lack no good thing and calls in a wave of the goodness and mercy of God.
mentions.quote: We thank you for a wave of the goodness and the mercy of God
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Taiwan bringing out legislation to frame the Bitcoin and crypto industry and calls it the Sooners moving first.
mentions.quote: Taiwan today bringing out legislation that is going to framework Bitcoin
mentions.falsify_match: Asian jurisdictions legislate ahead of America.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The original word named Japan and South Korea, not Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He lists Taiwan, South Korea and Japan all moving on crypto regulation as part of a coming new world order, saying the Bible tells them what is coming.
mentions.quote: when Taiwan starts to do it, South Korea did it, Japan does it
mentions.falsify_match: Coordinated Asian crypto regulation ahead of the West.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not materialise.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him specifically to pray for a particular man's health, naming his heart, arteries and prostate, and for a long life to sustain him because he is conservative.
mentions.quote: Pray for his heart. Pray for his arteries
mentions.falsify_match: A health event befalls a conservative figure in that position.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He does not name the man.

mentions.claim_text: He is reminded that Netanyahu rejected the two-state solution, having been told by text that it was a two-state solution.
mentions.quote: he said I reject the two-state solution
mentions.falsify_match: A two-state framework is agreed anyway.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Israeli rejection of a two-state solution is the standing position, not a change.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man standing out on something facing one direction while the projectile came from the other side, and says he is describing it as the Lord showed him.
mentions.quote: the projectile came from the right
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt matching that geometry.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attempt. He does not name the target in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says the war escalates because the euro is in trouble, that when the euro collapses the dollar is right behind it, that the euro fell first and then the dollar, and cites 3.9 billion for a drone manufacturer.
mentions.quote: when you see the euro collapse, the dollar's right behind it
mentions.falsify_match: A euro collapse followed by dollar weakness.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither currency collapses.

mentions.claim_text: He says the French president does the same thing that worked in Hitler's time and it will work again, and to watch key figures rising over Europe, America, Australia and Asia.
mentions.quote: it worked back then in Hitler's time and it'll work again
mentions.falsify_match: Macron consolidates emergency power in the manner described.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says a new glory will set in for persecution, that the greater the persecution the greater the revival, that refining fire comes out of it and brings great revival in Canada, and that he saw an olive press over the people's mouths.
mentions.quote: THE GREATER THE PERSECUTION, THE GREATER THE REVIVAL
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian church growth follows restrictions on speech.
mentions.falsify_miss: Restrictions reduce attendance instead. As put, persecution confirms it and its absence does not disconfirm it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw thirty thousand plus people go home, that it would be just like Venezuela, that the streets split, and that great fires broke out from there all the way to Anchorage, which he says he still does not understand.
mentions.quote: I saw 30,000 plus people go home
mentions.falsify_match: A Pacific northwest earthquake killing tens of thousands with fires north to Alaska.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event.

mentions.claim_text: He says things will be uncovered as a sign that a major revival is about to take place in those areas, that God has not let go of California, and that the Hollywood Hills are about to have a major revival.
mentions.quote: Hollywood Hills is about to have a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious movement in the Hollywood entertainment industry.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says a volcano will erupt and a tsunami will come with aftershocks in Eugene, and points to a 5.4 that just happened where he said it would, in the water.
mentions.quote: It just happened right where I told you it would happen
mentions.falsify_match: An offshore Oregon eruption and tsunami.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only ordinary offshore seismicity. The Blanco fracture zone off Oregon produces magnitude 5 events several times a year.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be bigger than an 8.0 when it happens with a major eruption, and tells listeners who live there that his household is protected because a thousand shall fall at his side.
mentions.quote: bigger than a 8.0 when it happens. Major eruption
mentions.falsify_match: A magnitude 8 or greater event off the Oregon coast with an eruption.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event.

mentions.claim_text: He says someone gave three dollars and thirty three cents to get him to debate a man about Mormon faith, and that he will not debate religious things.
mentions.quote: I do not debate religious things
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of policy.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says America is merging with Cuba and sees the Cuban flag moving, with America's flag merging into it.
mentions.quote: America will merge with Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A formal political union or protectorate.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such arrangement.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the red and white stripes of the American flag, not the star field, grabbing hold of Cuba's flag and pulling it so that half of Cuba's flag begins to transfer.
mentions.quote: Half of Cuba's flag is starting to transfer
mentions.falsify_match: A partial American incorporation of Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such arrangement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees another BP style oil spill in the Gulf, a disruption with an oil derrick, and hears sabotage coming on the derrick to poison the water and disrupt things.
mentions.quote: I hear sabotage is coming on the oil derek
mentions.falsify_match: A major Gulf oil platform incident attributed to sabotage.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such incident.

mentions.claim_text: He ties the oil sabotage to what happened in Iran and to an enemy within, and says to pray over the grid and the railroads, with devices on the tracks to derail railroad cars.
mentions.quote: Derailment of railroad cars with devices on the tracks
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate derailment using a device on the track.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such derailment.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Hawaii and Honolulu naming the main strip, and over mass events and fireworks shows, calling confusion into the enemy's camp.
mentions.quote: We pray over any kind these mass events, fireworks shows
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a Honolulu public event.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is parked on Hawaii, that he sees a pulse and Hawaii very strong, and repeats prayer over Hawaii several times, calling it serious.
mentions.quote: I see Hawaii. Very strong Hawaii. A pulse
mentions.falsify_match: A major event in Hawaii.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. A pulse is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He names three places in sequence, Nashville, Boston and New Orleans, repeated three times, and says it is something that makes your stomach feel sick.
mentions.quote: Nashville, Boston, New Orleans. Three
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks in those three cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attacks. The same three-city set has been given before with different rankings.

mentions.claim_text: He sees baseball stadiums and hears New York repeatedly, even going into October, praying over the Yankees and hearing safeties, tied to Boston.
mentions.quote: Even going into October. We pray over New York
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a New York or Boston stadium during the postseason.
mentions.falsify_miss: The postseason passes without incident.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the Yankees and the Boston Red Sox and says that is the one he was looking for.
mentions.quote: That's the one I was looking for
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at either club's stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No incident.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what it has to do with baseball, sees the stadiums with the lights on at night, and asks for prayer over the people and over mass gatherings.
mentions.quote: I see the stadiums. I see the lights on. It's at night
mentions.falsify_match: A night game incident at either stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No incident. He states he does not know what the baseball means.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the peace of Jerusalem, then says the Lord told him to remember the fox in Cuba and the fox with the Bay of Pigs concerning New Orleans.
mentions.quote: Remember the fox with the bay of pigs in Cuba concerning New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba originated action against New Orleans.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The fox is never identified.
